metadata.key_test: The framework's clean proof-of-concept for complexity-capacity matching: a resource-zero city-state with maximal institutions produces the dataset's top trajectory; high P1 predicts a non-violent separation. Safeguard E checked and explicitly NOT triggered (Malaysia rents below the rentier-capture band).
metadata.notes: Singapore/Malaysia are the supplied dataset anchors. WGI legacy-scale values and pillar/MI scores recorded in notes; resource rents are the load-bearing Safeguard-E figure.

pre_event.event_description: Singapore's expulsion from Malaysia (Aug 9, 1965), scored on a 1996 baseline over 1996-2024.

Singapore.notes: WGI Rule of Law 1996 ~1.4 (avg 1.46; legacy scale). Govt Effectiveness avg 2.21, 2024 = 2.28 (world #1). Political Stability avg 1.27. Natural resource rents ~0% (anti-rentier). Net donor by 1996. MI (existing dataset): 0.790 (1996) -> 0.939 (2024); P1 = 0.945, P4 = 0.988 (highest). Uniformly high pillars; narrow spread at the TOP (inverse of South Sudan's narrow spread at the floor).

Malaysia.notes: WGI Rule of Law 1996 = 0.50 (its own max; avg 0.25, 2024 = 0.35; legacy scale). Govt Effectiveness 1996 = 0.54 (its own min; avg 0.97). Natural resource rents avg 17.6% (1970-2021); ~7-18% in the 1996 era; 2021 = 6.92% - BELOW the 25-30% Safeguard E threshold. Modest ODA recipient. MI: 0.376 (1996) -> 0.518 (2024), Tier 3. Derived P1 approx 0.65; moderate across the board.

analysis.overall_assessment: 5 applicable predictions: 5 CONFIRMED, 0 PARTIAL, 0 FALSIFIED. Cleanest confirmation in Run 2. Safeguard E was checked and explicitly NOT triggered (Malaysia rents ~7-18%, below the rentier-capture band).
analysis.what_this_case_uniquely_reveals: Singapore is the framework's complexity-control flagship and genuine proof-of-concept for complexity-capacity matching: with zero natural endowment, institutional quality alone (P1 = 0.945, world-highest Government Effectiveness 2.28) produced the dataset's best trajectory. The MI weights P1 at 34% and Singapore maxes exactly that pillar. Humility note: small scale and city-state geography reduce the complexity its capacity must match - a best-case rather than a generalizable template.
analysis.baseline_impact: None; confirms the existing weighting without proposing a modification.
analysis.strict_recode_note: Strict re-code applied per run6 (post-hoc d-dimension -> PARTIAL; narrow-gap a-trajectory annotated with Mod4). Honest aggregate target ~62-78%.
